scenes.title: Past Life · The Borrowed Pen
scenes.summary: On the morning of the SAT, outside the testing center, Shen Man asks Lin Zhixia to lend her a pen. Lin Zhixia hands one over without thinking. When Shen Man returns it, her fingertip lingers on the barrel for half a second.
scenes.text: SAT morning. Outside the testing center. Lin Zhixia silently recites math formulas. Shen Man walks up: "Zhixia, lend me a pen. Mine just ran dry." Lin Zhixia pulls one from her pencil case and hands it over. Shen Man takes it, scribbles twice on scratch paper, and gives it back: "Thanks. This one writes nice." Lin Zhixia doesn't think twice. She doesn't see that when Shen Man returns the pen, her fingertip rests on the barrel for half a second.

scenes.title: Past Life · Score Night
scenes.summary: Lin Zhixia checks her SAT score: only 1120. Her appeal to the College Board is denied. Shen Man scores 1580 and lands an Early Decision spot at an elite university. A faint blue mark on her palm fades.
scenes.text: Late night. Score check. The College Board page flashes "1120." Lin Zhixia refreshes a dozen times. Her hands shake harder each time. Her mother leans over to look, then her legs give out and she sinks into a chair. Her homeroom teacher, Old Chen, is stunned on the phone: "Impossible. I've taught for twenty years... I'll help you file a score anomaly appeal with the College Board right away." Three days later, the appeal is denied. The reply is four words: Score verified. Meanwhile, Shen Man scores 1580 and lands an Early Decision spot at that top university. The whole school buzzes. In an interview she says, "I just had a good day." Then her eyes go blank for a second. She glances down at the hand that took the pen: a faint blue mark on her palm is fading. The comments all praise her: "Rich and she still works this hard."

scenes.title: Past Life · The Rooftop
scenes.summary: On the rooftop, Shen Man admits she used the Score-Swap System to steal Lin Zhixia's SAT score and bribed the College Board review. She pushes Lin Zhixia off the roof to her death.
scenes.text: The day the Early Decision confirmation is due, an anonymous text lures her to the rooftop. Shen Man drops all pretense: "You think I got in because of my dad? His three million bought off the College Board review. The swap—I did that myself." Lin Zhixia: "You?" Shen Man holds out her hand. The blue mark on her palm is almost invisible now: "That pen of yours. It writes nice. Guess why I had to borrow it?" Lin Zhixia turns to leave—to report it, to call the police. Footsteps close in behind her. Two hands shove hard against her back. In the rushing wind of the fall, Shen Man's voice drifts down from the roof's edge: "Next life, don't lend your pen to just anyone." What the world thinks was a suicide was a murder from start to finish.

scenes.title: Rebirth · The Switch
scenes.summary: Lin Zhixia wakes up on the morning of the SAT. She writes a three-line plan and places Zhou Yu's pen in the outermost pocket of her pencil case.
scenes.text: She opens her eyes. It's the morning of the SAT. The SAT registration number on her desk, her mother's porridge by the door, the date on her phone—exactly as she remembers. Lin Zhixia pinches the back of her hand. It hurts. She sits at her desk for ten minutes, then writes three lines in her notebook: "One, she borrows a pen to swap scores. The pen is the anchor. Two, don't lend her mine. Three, that push on the rooftop—this time she hits air. And I record it." She closes the notebook and checks her pencil case: her own pen, a spare, and one Zhou Yu left on her desk last week. She puts Zhou Yu's pen in the outermost pocket.

scenes.title: Rebirth · The Testing Center
scenes.summary: Shen Man asks to borrow a pen again. Lin Zhixia lends her Zhou Yu's pen. When Shen Man returns it, her fingertip still lingers for half a second.
scenes.text: Before the final SAT section, Shen Man walks up just like before: "Zhixia, lend me a pen. Mine ran dry." Lin Zhixia smiles and pulls the pen from the outermost pocket: "Here." Shen Man takes it and scribbles twice. Lin Zhixia notices her grip is strange, like she's feeling for something. When she returns it, her fingertip rests on the barrel for half a second—exactly like last time. Lin Zhixia takes it back, drops it in her pencil case, and never touches that pen again.

scenes.title: Replay · Score Night
scenes.summary: On College Board score night, Lin Zhixia scores 1580, Zhou Yu scores 1120, and Shen Man scores only 980 and posts about it in the class group chat.
scenes.text: College Board score night. Lin Zhixia enters her SAT registration number. The screen flashes: 1580—exactly what she estimated after the test. She stares for a few seconds, refreshes, still 1580. Her phone rings. Zhou Yu's voice trembles: "Zhixia, I got 1120. But I estimated only around 980!" She grips the phone, starts to smile, then stops halfway. Meanwhile, the class group chat explodes: Shen Man posts a screenshot of her score—"980. How is this possible?" The comments go silent for a long time. Someone asks carefully: "Man, did they maybe make a mistake?" Shen Man doesn't reply.

scenes.title: Zhou Yu's Score
scenes.summary: After her College Board appeal fails, Zhou Yu confronts Lin Zhixia. Shen Man barges in and lets slip that she knew Zhou Yu's original score. Lin Zhixia admits she deliberately lent Zhou Yu's pen to Shen Man.
scenes.text: The next day, Zhou Yu rushes to Lin Zhixia's house, eyes red: "I appealed to the College Board. They say my 1120 is verified. But I estimated only around 980!" Before Lin Zhixia can speak, Shen Man pushes through the door. She snatches Zhou Yu's phone, sees 1120, and blurts out: "You only had 980!" Zhou Yu fires back: "Scores just came out. How do you know my original score?" Shen Man's face changes. She slams the phone down and storms out. Zhou Yu turns to Lin Zhixia: "Zhixia, do you know something?" After a long silence, Lin Zhixia speaks: "That pen. The one she borrowed. It was yours." Zhou Yu freezes: "What pen?" "On SAT day she borrowed a pen. I handed her yours." Zhou Yu's face slowly changes: "You did it on purpose?" Lin Zhixia doesn't deny it. "So you protected yourself and pushed me out?" Lin Zhixia: "I didn't think it would go this far. I thought she was swapping—" "You thought? That was my SAT. What do you mean, you thought?" The door slams. Lin Zhixia sits in the dark, not turning on the light for a long time.

scenes.title: The Rooftop · Closing the Net
scenes.summary: Shen Man threatens Lin Zhixia by phone. The next night on the rooftop, Lin Zhixia sets a trap with a camera and recorder. The police, Zhou Yu, and Old Song arrive to close the net.
scenes.text: That night, Shen Man calls, voice shaking: "It was you. You switched my pen." Lin Zhixia: "I didn't switch anything. I just didn't lend you mine." "Do you know how long I prepared?!" "Zhou Yu prepared longer." Three seconds of silence. "You're dead." The next night, 8 p.m. The rooftop. Lin Zhixia goes: an action camera clipped to her backpack strap, a voice recorder hidden in her sleeve. Zhou Yu waits in the stairwell—not to help her, but to hear Shen Man admit the swap with her own ears and get her score back. Shen Man steps up holding a pen: "Do you know what this is? All I have to do is write your name—" "Write it." Lin Zhixia cuts her off. "You swapped Zhou Yu once. Swap me again, and the log shows two entries. You can delete the server, but not the offline backup. You have one choice: admit the swap and give Zhou Yu her score back." Shen Man lunges. Lin Zhixia sidesteps. Shen Man can't stop herself and slams into the railing. Footsteps thunder up the stairwell—the police, Zhou Yu, and Old Song, the technician the Shen family fired, holding a printout of the system log.

scenes.title: The Log
scenes.summary: Three days earlier, Lin Zhixia found Old Song. He shows her the Score-Swap module in the scoring system log, proving the system automatically swapped scores and flagged "target error, rollback recommended."
scenes.text: Three days earlier, Lin Zhixia knocked on Old Song's door. In her past life, during score week, a forum post from someone claiming to be inside the scoring system was deleted within seconds. She memorized the ID. This life, she followed the trail. Old Song spreads the printout on the table: an unsigned anomaly module, code name "Score-Swap," with only two fields—"Borrower: Shen Man. Lent-from: Zhou Yu. Swap result: Success." Three days later, a new status line appears: "Target error. Rollback recommended." Lin Zhixia: "The system knows it swapped the wrong person." Old Song: "The system isn't stupid. It just doesn't care." Zhou Yu stands in the doorway, voice barely audible: "So my score was marked 'recommended to ignore'?" Old Song says nothing. He slides the USB drive across the table.

scenes.title: The Trial
scenes.summary: Police open a case. Shen Man's lawyer argues the system doesn't exist. The prosecution submits three pieces of evidence. The judge asks Shen Man why her first reaction to a low SAT score was to call Lin Zhixia instead of appealing to the College Board.
scenes.text: Police open a case. Shen Man's lawyer argues: "The so-called system doesn't exist." The prosecution submits three things: Old Song's offline log, the rooftop recording, and a screenshot of Shen Man's post from score night. In court, the judge asks Shen Man: "You saw your SAT was only 980. Why was your first reaction to call Lin Zhixia instead of filing a score anomaly appeal with the College Board?" Shen Man opens her mouth. Nothing comes out. Lin Zhixia sits in the gallery, not looking at her.

scenes.title: Reckoning
scenes.summary: Official notice: Shen Man is arrested, her father is investigated for bribery, and Shen Group goes bankrupt. Zhou Yu's score is restored, but the two can't go back to how things were.
scenes.text: Official notice: Shen Man used an unidentified "Score-Swap System" to illegally swap scoring data, suspected of unauthorized modification of computer systems and attempted murder. She is arrested. Her father is investigated for bribing the review process with three million. The bribery chain is exposed. Shen Group's stock drops for seven straight days, banks pull their loans, and the company declares bankruptcy. The origin of the "Score-Swap System" is unknown and has been handed to a specialized agency for investigation. Zhou Yu's score is restored based on her answer sheet. The day her admission letter arrives, she sends Lin Zhixia a message: "My score is back. But we can't go back." Lin Zhixia stares at the screen for a long time, then replies with one word: "Yeah."

scenes.title: Epilogue: Admission and Choice
scenes.summary: Lin Zhixia receives her admission letter. She and Zhou Yu message each other about their majors. She leaves a note and the pen, hinting the system is still waiting for the next person to borrow a pen.
scenes.text: The day Lin Zhixia's admission letter arrives, her mother wipes the envelope three times before daring to open it. Her phone lights up. A message from Zhou Yu: "I'm going for teaching. I'll be a teacher. No one swaps a student's score on my watch." Lin Zhixia smiles and types back: "I'm going for law." "Why?" "Because the system is still out there. Someone has to watch it." She places the pen—Zhou Yu's pen—under the glass on her desk, with a sticky note pressed beside it: "This time, every point is mine. Next time, no one takes it." But she doesn't throw the pen away. The system hasn't disappeared. It's just changed its method, waiting for the next person to borrow a pen.
